title: fix(components)!: NavigationOverlay drops its unused comments prop

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;只是记录侧边抽屉组件删掉了一个早已没人传入的评论按钮入口。
- 为什么做:收尾「评论通知直达评论」这张卡的第二项清理,上一项已在之前的合并里完成。
- 出错会怎样:只有自己写代码向抽屉传评论按钮的集成方会编译报错,删掉该参数即可;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

Item 2 of the card, the last open item (item 1 landed earlier; see the card's release comment).

- `@object-ui/components` `NavigationOverlay` drops its `comments` prop: the `NavigationOverlayProps.comments` declaration, its destructure, and the pass-through into the drawer's `RecordTopBar`.
- `RecordTopBar` keeps its own `comments` slot. It is still filled by the record page: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` passes `comments={phoneCommentsButton}` on the phone bar and `comments={shellActions ? undefined : commentsButton}` on the desktop bar.
- Changeset `.changeset/36410-navigation-overlay-comments-prop.md`: `@object-ui/components` patch, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/components#NavigationOverlayProps.comments)`, and the FROM-TO line, in the shape of the earlier `NavigationOverlayProps.maximizable` removal.

Premise, measured on `origin/main` 9171bed0a before the change: no caller passes `comments` to `NavigationOverlay`. Every render site under `ui/`, `examples/`, `packages/` and `apps/` was read (27 sites, including the e2e harness `ui/e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts`, which passes mode, isOverlay, isOpen, selectedRecord, close, setIsOpen, width, title, onExpand, expandLabel, children). The spread sites spread `useNavigationOverlay`'s result (no `comments` in the hook) or ObjectGrid's `recordOverlayShellProps` (storageKey, legacyStorageKey, width).

## Read first

1. `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`: the three removals and the bar comment.
2. `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/navigation-overlay-bar-26679.test.tsx`: the new top-level describe (type pin plus render check).
3. `.changeset/36410-navigation-overlay-comments-prop.md`: the disposition marker and FROM-TO line.

## Two-minute check

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/components exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/navigation-overlay-bar-26679.test.tsx`: expect all tests to pass, including "the drawer bar takes no comments switch".

- The pin goes into the existing drawer bar harness: a `@ts-expect-error` on a partial `NavigationOverlayProps` object carrying `comments` (compiled by the package's `tsconfig.test.json`), and a render check that a stray `comments` is not drawn in the bar.
- `record-top-bar-comments-36075.test.tsx`: docblock only. It no longer says the drawer hands the switch on.
